author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Can you find it
No
You're searching
Has to be lost
All forgot.
Twist around.
Amongst the stares.
Stolen memories
Forgotten fares
Dropping your lens
Spins up truth
Destiny's Unbound
Answers anchored
